title: Zee wipe
brief: Character-led bumpers for people who scroll past app ads (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube bumpers). The single idea: Zee, a black plush kitten, is the transition. She leaps at the lens and her fur blacks out the frame, her silhouette opens a window onto the next moment, she whips across the screen; behind her is Emma's real app: a look landing, the Wardrobe, the carousel, two try-ons, a trip look, 'Me too.' Three 6 s bumpers (looks, wardrobe, try-ons: prop `bumper`), each a seamless loop that opens on her fur pulling away from the lens and ends with her leaping back into it, plus a 15 s compilation. From concept c7.
hook: 0–0.6 s: Zee leaps straight at the camera and her fur fills the frame on the track's first hit.
disclosures: The try-on photos of Emma are AI-generated (Emma is an AI persona): turn on the platform AI label for the 15 s compilation and the try-ons bumper (TikTok "AI-generated content", Meta "AI info", YouTube "altered or synthetic content"). The looks and wardrobe bumpers show only the app and Zee.
Zee is an animated character; the app footage is real (Curate 1.5.0, build 262, Emma's account).
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Can't Get You Off My Mind, Michael Ramir C.): online and social ads only; never Content ID.
notes: 6 s bumpers: render with tools/render zee-wipe --length 6 --props '{"bumper":"wardrobe"}' --name wardrobe (looks is the default). Music from 24.95 s: the first hit (25.58 s) is the first fur peak; the track's half-second drop-outs before every fourth bar are where she leaps at the lens. Every cut also renders in 4x5 (--format 4x5); the 15 s also in 1x1 (--format 1x1 --channel meta-feed). The 15 s mix is +0.17 dB over the bumpers' to sit inside −14 ±1 LUFS.
